items.summary:

items.title: GLM-5.2 First Test | Frontier-Level Open Weight Model? | Agentic Coding, Web Design, Logic Puzzles
items.summary:
GLM 5.2 by Z.ai is a ~750B open weight LLM that is optimized for agentic/long--running tasks that is a serious contender for the number 1 spot of best open model. It has 1M context window (up from ~200k in GLM 5.1) and supports only text input/output. How close it is to the frontier models, what is required to run it and how good it is? Let's try it out!

Post: https://z.ai/blog/glm-5.2
Run GLM 5.2 locally: https://unsloth.ai/docs/models/glm-5.2
GLM 5.2 on OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/z-ai/glm-5.2
